translation_snapshot.source:
#GOLD#Damage resistance: by speed#LAST#
All damage you receive, through any means, is decreased by this percentage, which increases as your total movement speed (global times movement) decreases.
This is applied after normal damage type resistances.
translation_snapshot.target:
#GOLD#伤害抗性：速度#LAST#
所有类型任何方式对你造成的伤害按此值减免，随着你的总体移动速度减少而增加。
该效果在常规伤害抗性后生效，不受抗性穿透影响。

translation_snapshot.source: The way to combat magic, or even nullify it.
translation_snapshot.target: 你选择终生与魔法对抗并试图永远终结它。

translation_snapshot.source:
Brings the target's inner demons to the surface.  Each turn, for %d turns, there's a %d%% chance that a demon will surface, requiring the target to make a Mental Save to keep it from manifesting.
		If the target is sleeping, the chance to save will be halved, and fear immunity will be ignored.  Otherwise, if the summoning is resisted, the effect will end early.
		The summon chance will scale with your Mindpower and the demon's life will scale with the target's rank.
		If a demon manifests the sheer terror will remove all sleep effects from the victim, but not the Inner Demons.
translation_snapshot.target:
使目标的心魔具象化。在 %d 回合内，每回合有 %d%% 的几率会召唤一个心魔，需要目标进行一次精神豁免鉴定，失败则心魔具象化。
		如果目标处于睡眠状态，豁免概率减半，且无视目标的恐惧免疫。若目标豁免鉴定成功，则心魔的效果提前结束。
		受精神强度影响，召唤几率按比例加成。
		心魔的生命值受目标分级加成。
		心魔具现化时，会移除目标身上的所有睡眠类效果，本技能除外。

translation_snapshot.source: #VIOLET#You enter the swirling portal and in the blink of an eye you set foot in sight of the Gates of Morning, with no trace of the portal...
translation_snapshot.target: #VIOLET#你进入了传送漩涡，一眨眼的功夫你已经到了晨曦之门的山脚下，此间毫无传送门的痕迹……

translation_snapshot.source: A burning giant wielding a forge hammer of the underworld in each hand -- weapons imbued by Urh'Rok himself with the power to crush and shape felsteel. Enter their range at your peril.
translation_snapshot.target: 锻造巨人的每只手都有一柄地底锻造巨锤——被乌鲁洛克加持以锻造魔钢的巨锤。进入他们的领地是极度危险的事情。

translation_snapshot.source: No rogue blades shall incapacitate the wearer of this armour.
translation_snapshot.target: 盗贼之刃将不能加于装备者之身。

translation_snapshot.source: Each time you consume a mark, you gain %d%% increased attack speed for 2 turns and the cooldown of %d random techniques are reduced by %d turns.
translation_snapshot.target: 每次消耗标记时，获得 %d%% 攻击速度 2 回合，并减少 %d 个战斗技巧系技能冷却时间 %d 回合。

translation_snapshot.source: This monstrous form of putrid, torn flesh and chipped bone drags its mass towards you, spurting blood and viscera along the way.
translation_snapshot.target: 这块腐烂的被切碎的血肉，挣扎着向你移动，在路上喷出的血液和内脏。

translation_snapshot.source: drain blood from all creatures within range 5, causing them to bleed for %0.2f physical damage over 4 turns (based on your Physicalpower). For each creature drained (up to 10), the armor gains strength, which fades over 10 turns if it is not fed
translation_snapshot.target: 吸收半径 5 内所有生物的血液，令其在 4 回合内受到 %0.2f 点物理伤害（基于你的物理强度）。每吸收一个生物（至多10个），护甲的属性便会增强；若不再喂食，增益会在 10 回合后消退。
